q: Time is measured in years, months, days, hours, minutes and seconds, but the SI unit for time is the ____.
e: Time is measured in years, months, days, hours, minutes and seconds, but the SI unit for time is the second (s). SI writes every quantity as a number times an agreed unit.

q: Most common modern clocks and watches depend on the vibration of ____ to keep time accurately.
e: Most common modern clocks and watches depend on the vibration of quartz crystals to keep time accurately. The physics in this sentence is built around quartz crystals.

q: The energy to keep these crystals vibrating comes from a ____.
e: The energy to keep these crystals vibrating comes from a small battery. The physics in this sentence is built around small battery.

q: A stopwatch (or) a stop clock can be chosen to measure the time to an accuracy of a ____.
e: A stopwatch (or) a stop clock can be chosen to measure the time to an accuracy of a few tenths of a second. The physics in this sentence is built around few tenths of a second.

q: Digital stopwatches can measure up to ____.
e: Digital stopwatches can measure up to 0.01 s. The physics in this sentence is built around 0.01 s.
